what: A failed build printed 150 lines of `Cargo.toml` `unused_workspace_dependencies` warnings and no error: the script's `grep -E "^(error|warning: unused)" -A12 ... | head -150` is filled by them. Reading /root/loop-build.log afterwards showed another lane's build.
cost: two build rounds (about ten minutes) without seeing the three errors
cause: the filter matches cargo's manifest warnings; the log is shared
fix: loop.sh greps `^error` alone and writes the log to /root/loop-build.<branch>.log
